name: Leave No Context Behind: Efficient Infinite Context Transformers with Infini-attention
problem: An LLM serving long or unbounded input either pays quadratic cost or must truncate, and the usual compressions (sliding window, sparse attention) lose the distant context that mattered.
mechanism: Infini-attention: build a compressive memory into vanilla attention, so ONE Transformer block carries masked LOCAL attention plus long-term LINEAR attention against a bounded compressed memory (a continuous-weight causal summary rather than a discrete token summary). Memory and computation stay bounded by the compression size regardless of input length, which is what makes streaming inference possible.
speedup_reported: NOT A THROUGHPUT CLAIM. The abstract reports effectiveness on long-context language modelling, 1M-length passkey block retrieval and 500K-length book summarisation at 1B and 8B, plus 'minimal bounded memory parameters' and 'fast streaming inference'. No multiplier, no baseline engine. The bounded-memory property is the architectural claim worth carrying.
